1.w: Praise the Lord . Praise the name of the Lord . Offer praise, you servants of the Lord ,

2.w: who serve in the Lord ’s temple, in the courts of the temple of our God.

3.w: Praise the Lord , for the Lord is good. Sing praises to his name, for it is pleasant.

4.w: Indeed, the Lord has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel to be his special possession.

5.w: Yes, I know the Lord is great, and our Lord is superior to all gods.

6.w: He does whatever he pleases in heaven and on earth, in the seas and all the ocean depths.

7.w: He causes the clouds to arise from the end of the earth, makes lightning bolts accompany the rain, and brings the wind out of his storehouses.

8.w: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, including both men and animals.

9.w: He performed awesome deeds and acts of judgment in your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.

10.w: He defeated many nations, and killed mighty kings—

11.w: Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan.

12.w: He gave their land as an inheritance, as an inheritance to Israel his people.

13.w: O Lord , your name endures, your reputation, O Lord , lasts.

14.w: For the Lord vindicates his people and has compassion on his servants.

15.w: The nations’ idols are made of silver and gold; they are man-made.

16.w: They have mouths, but cannot speak, eyes, but cannot see,

17.w: and ears, but cannot hear. Indeed, they cannot breathe.

18.w: Those who make them will end up like them, as will everyone who trusts in them.

19.w: O family of Israel, praise the Lord . O family of Aaron, praise the Lord .

20.w: O family of Levi, praise the Lord . You loyal followers of the Lord , praise the Lord .

21.w: The Lord deserves praise in Zion — he who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the Lord .
